title: Family communication plan
h1: Family communication: out-of-area contact, school pickup, reunification
dek: How a household stays in touch and gets back together when phones jam and family members are in different places: the out-of-area contact, the plan card, meeting places, and what to ask your child's school.
description: A family communication plan from Ready.gov, the FCC and the CDC: an out-of-area contact, a written plan, meeting places, texting, school pickup and reunification.
recheck: If Ready.gov, the FCC or the CDC revise these pages; the FCC and Colorado pages are undated and should be re-checked first. Otherwise at the next quarterly source sweep.

safety_review.scope: Not safety-gated in the taxonomy; recorded as pending because the page concerns children's reunification and relies on one state-specific school source and one undated FCC page.

source_use.shelter-ready-plan-locations: Plan for school and daycare; ask about alerts, evacuation and shelter-in-place plans; backup plans for children; neighbors and apartments.
